name: sakura-monorepo
description: Sakura's npm-workspaces monorepo, covering the coexistence period of docs/history/web-migration/framework-migration-plan.md. legacy/ is the current production single-file app (index.html/hub.html), unchanged in behavior by this restructuring — deploy.yml still builds and publishes legacy/ exclusively. web/ is the new React app; not deployed anywhere until the migration's own Phase 5 cutover.
